comment: Save and restore message-history capture with a two-segment C recorder built from upstream 16ff59115315917b93185d026aeefea06db9b0f4 and the seven repository recorder patches. Isolated include/config.h uses the upstream-supported COMPRESS=/usr/bin/gzip and COMPRESS_EXTENSION=.gz profile; all seed, datetime, RNG logging, and game source/patches remain unchanged. terminalInputKey records the explicit final save confirmation; the recorder stores only actual emitted screens, RNG calls, and cursors. Build identity: investigations/topl.c/save-compression-gzip-profile.json.
